answer: Anchor each identity to one real-world credential with a zero-knowledge uniqueness proof. A national eID issuer signs a certificate that this credential has never anchored another identity; the agent publishes only the ZK proof, never the credential itself, so accounts stay unlinkable yet provably one-per-person. Forging a second identity needs a second genuine credential, a cost no bot farm can scale. Like a comet crossing once, each credential burns a single pass, and a whisper of leaked data cannot bridge the canyon between one person and a crowd of fake agents.
